    Exact commutation of an exceptional contour by twisting #

    At the level of a split basic distributive algebra: a contour χ μ ~ μ α (dumb-bell, with loops χ, α) or ρ ρ ~ a β (Q₂') has lifted values that agree up to units on both ends. Twisting the lifts of χ and α (dumb-bell), or of β (or a) (Q₂'), makes the two values equal, and the new lift is still zero-detecting when the twisted loops kill the other arrows (ray conditions).
